definitions.short: properly, to foam at the mouth, i.e. to be enraged
definitions.full: H2194. zaam זָעַם verb be indignant (compare Aramaic (rare) blame , & noun ; Arabic onomatopoetic, of roar of camel, angry speech , see Frey, De on Psa 7:12 ) — Perfect ׳ז Num 23:8 3 t.; זָעַמְתָּה Zech 1:12 ; Imperfect אֶזְעֹם Num 23:8 ; 3 plural suffix יִזְעָמוּהוּ Prov 24:24 ; Imperative זֹעֲמָה Num 23:7 (for זָָֽעָמֳה Ges § 64 , (2)); Participle active זֹעֵם Psa 7:12 ; passive construct זְעוּם Prov 22:14 ; feminine זְעוּמָה Micah 6:10 ; — 1 be indignant, have indignation , of hostile prince קוֺדֶשׁ בְּרִית עַל Dan 11:30 ; elsewhere of Yahweh, who is זֹעֵם אֵל Psa 7:12 (|| שׁוֺפֵט ), with accusative of enemy Isa 66:14 ; cities of Judah Zech 1:12 ; people Mal 1:4 ; a man Prov 22:14 . 2 **[ 2 is probably denominative from זַעַם (see Buhl).] express indignation in speech, denounce, curse || יִקְּבֻהוּ Prov 24:24 ; || אֶקֹּב and אָֽרָהֿ Num 23:7-8 , (twice in verse) (E); רָזוֺן אֵיפַת זְעוּמָה Micah 6:10 an ephah of scantiness, denounced , or cursed . Niph`al Participle plural נִזְעָמִים מָּנִים Prov 25:23 face stirred with indignation .
